title: Ashbury Rewards Points Ledger: Night Value of a Reward Night Rate Reservation
content:
**Scope.** The night value of an Ashbury Rewards Reward Night Rate reservation is the points value of one night of that reservation when points come back after a cancellation recorded after the deadline or a no-show. It is read from the points the reservation deducted and from the nights on its Room Reservations record.

## Rule

The night value depends on how the reservation was paid:

1. **First night paid with a Free Night Award.** A reservation with one or more certificate nights — nights paid with Free Night Awards, shown on its Room Reservations record — had its first night paid with a Free Night Award, and its night value is zero.
2. **First night paid with points, long points stay with the fifth-night saving.** A reservation whose first night was paid with points and which has five or more points nights on a tier with the fifth-night saving takes as night value the points it deducted divided by all of its points nights, rounded down to a whole point.

The points nights of the reservation are its nights less its certificate nights; the points it deducted are its award redemptions less any redeposit already naming it.

## Decision table

| Certificate nights | Points nights | Tier has the fifth-night saving | Night value under this standard |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | any | any | Zero |
| 0 | 5 or more | Yes | Points deducted divided by all points nights, rounded down |
| 0 | 4 or fewer | any | No valuation under this standard |
| 0 | any | No | No valuation under this standard |

## Worked figures (hypothetical reservations)

- Six nights, no certificate night, member at Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite, 125000 points deducted: 125000 divided by 6 points nights is 20833.33, rounded down to 20833.
- Four nights, one certificate night, 75000 points deducted: the first night was paid with a Free Night Award and the night value is zero.
